body.x: FitNlife introduced ‘fitness band’, fashion item for the most accurate health data at 'CES 2018 Unveiled' in 7th of January in Las Vegas, United States.

FitNlife uses an advanced, clinically validated tracking technology to provide the most accurate health data for its users. This enables users to easily understand the health effects of daily activities and helps them understand which ones are directly healthy through FitNlife applications. All sequential actions can be measured 32 times per second and MET is used to analyze the health impact.
Consisting of sporty silicon bands, fashionable leather bands, and premium leather bands, FitNlife’s fitness band is adjustable depending on the user's wrist and have a battery lasting 14 days.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
